name: Carousel
summary: A horizontal strip of cards shown one group at a time, moved by previous and next buttons, dot navigation, drag or autoplay. Use it for a small set of peer items the user browses in order; use tabs when the sections have names and a list when all should be visible.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: A CarouselViewport holding a CarouselSlider of CarouselCards, then a CarouselNavContainer with its prev, next, autoplay buttons and a CarouselNav of dots or image buttons.

inputs.name: activeIndex
inputs.description: The page shown; defaultActiveIndex for uncontrolled use; onActiveIndexChange reports changes with their cause.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: flat is the bare strip; elevated adds outer spacing, gaps between cards, and rounds and lifts each card.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Where the active card settles within the viewport.

inputs.name: circular
inputs.description: Loops from the last page to the first and back.

inputs.name: groupSize
inputs.description: Cards per page; auto (the default) fits as many as the viewport shows.

inputs.name: draggable
inputs.description: Lets the pointer drag the strip.

inputs.name: whitespace
inputs.description: Adds empty space at the ends so align holds for the first and last cards.

inputs.name: motion
inputs.description: slide scrolls the strip under an attraction physics with a unitless speed (25 by default, 20 to 60 recommended); fade cross-fades cards in place.

inputs.name: autoplayInterval
inputs.description: Milliseconds between pages while autoplay is on.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: A CarouselNavContainer option: controls under the strip, spread to its edges, laid over its bottom, spread over its bottom, or with prev and next at the sides mid-height.

inputs.name: cardFocus
inputs.description: A CarouselSlider option: the cards form a focus group moved through with the arrow keys.

anatomy.name: Carousel
anatomy.description: The relatively positioned box that clips horizontal overflow; elevated adds spacingVerticalL margin and padding around it.

anatomy.name: CarouselViewport
anatomy.description: The visible window, auto width at most 100%.

anatomy.name: CarouselSlider
anatomy.description: The flex row of cards that moves; elevated spaces them spacingHorizontalXXL apart.

anatomy.name: CarouselCard
anatomy.description: One item, the full viewport width unless autoSize, at most 100%; elevated rounds it to borderRadiusXLarge, clips it and casts shadow16.

anatomy.name: CarouselNavContainer
anatomy.description: The row of controls: prev, nav, next and autoplay, centred, pointer-transparent except its buttons; inline below the strip or overlaid on it.

anatomy.name: CarouselNav
anatomy.description: A centred pill of dots on Neutral Background Alpha, rounded to borderRadiusXLarge with spacingHorizontalS side margins, focusable as a group.

anatomy.name: CarouselNavButton
anatomy.description: A dot: an 8px circle in Foreground 1 at 60% inside spacingVerticalS by spacingHorizontalS padding, widening to a 16px bar when selected; brand appearance fills Compound Brand Background.

anatomy.name: CarouselNavImageButton
anatomy.description: A 40px image thumbnail (48px when selected) with borderRadiusSmall corners and a transparent border, spacingHorizontalXS side margins.

anatomy.name: CarouselButton
anatomy.description: A Button for prev or next, vertically centred, in Foreground 2 on Neutral Background Alpha.

anatomy.name: CarouselAutoplayButton
anatomy.description: A ToggleButton for autoplay, vertically centred, in Foreground 2 on Neutral Background Alpha with a transparent border.

variants.description: No outer spacing, no gaps, cards unstyled.
spacingVerticalL margin and padding around the root so shadows have room, spacingHorizontalXXL between cards, and each card rounded to borderRadiusXLarge with shadow16.
Dots fill Compound Brand Background (Hover and Pressed on interaction) at full opacity when selected; unselected stay Foreground 1 at 60%.
The nav container sits below the strip with spacingVerticalM above.
As inline, with prev pushed to the far start and next to the far end.
The nav container is absolutely placed spacingVerticalM above the strip's bottom edge.
As overlay, with prev at the far start and next at the far end, each spacingHorizontalM in; autoplay takes spacingHorizontalM before it.

The container fills the strip: prev and next are absolutely placed spacingHorizontalM from the sides at mid-height, the nav sits spacingVerticalL above the bottom, and autoplay sits at the bottom start.
The strip scrolls to the page under an attraction physics at speed 25 (unitless).

layout.text: The root clips horizontal overflow only, so a focus outline can bleed vertically, and is relatively positioned for the overlaid controls; elevated adds spacingVerticalL margin and padding so card shadows are not clipped.

The viewport is auto width at most 100%; the slider is a flex row, spacingHorizontalXXL apart when elevated; each card is flex 0 0 100% at most 100% wide (0 0 auto with autoSize), and elevated rounds it to borderRadiusXLarge, clips it and casts shadow16.

The container is a centred flex row the full width, pointer-transparent; inline adds spacingVerticalM above, overlay places it absolutely spacingVerticalM from the bottom; wide layouts push prev and next to the ends with an spacingHorizontalM inset when overlaid; overlay-expanded stretches it over the strip, places prev and next spacingHorizontalM from the sides at 50% height, raises the nav spacingVerticalL, and puts autoplay at the bottom start spacingHorizontalM in.

The nav is a centred flex row on colorNeutralBackgroundAlpha rounded to borderRadiusXLarge with auto vertical and spacingHorizontalS horizontal margins, taking pointer events, with a group focus indicator (strokeWidthThick colorStrokeFocus2, borderRadiusMedium).

A dot button is spacingHorizontalS by spacingVerticalS, content-box, padded the same on each side, borderless and transparent; its glyph is a round spacingHorizontalS by spacingVerticalS box in Foreground 1. Selected, the button is spacingHorizontalL wide with spacingHorizontalXS side padding and the glyph spacingHorizontalL wide with a 4px radius.

An image button is a 40px square (48px when selected) with borderRadiusSmall corners, a colorTransparentStroke border, no padding and spacingHorizontalXS side margins, clipping its image which fills it.

The prev, next and autoplay buttons are Buttons (autoplay a ToggleButton) with auto vertical margins, Foreground 2 on colorNeutralBackgroundAlpha, taking pointer events; autoplay adds a colorTransparentStroke border.

states.text: An unselected dot's glyph is at 60% opacity, 75% hovered and 100% pressed; selected is 100%, 75% hovered and 65% pressed. Brand fills Compound Brand Background, Hover and Pressed at full opacity when selected and keeps the neutral 60/75/100 when not.
A dot draws a strokeWidthThick colorStrokeFocus2 border with a matching negative margin and borderRadiusMedium corners; a strokeWidthThin transparent outline is always present for high contrast.
The selected image button grows from 40 to 48px.

states.label: autoplaying
states.text: The autoplay button is a checked ToggleButton while autoplay runs; the carousel advances every autoplayInterval and stops on any interaction.

behaviour.text: Prev and next move one page (a group of cards) in their direction; a dot or image button jumps to its page; with circular the ends wrap.
Unset options default to align center, not circular, group size auto, not draggable, no whitespace, slide motion at speed 25, autoplay every 4000ms and flat appearance.
The strip moves under Embla's attraction physics with the motion speed, not a timed easing: 25 by default, 20 to 60 recommended, and a drag's speed comes from the drag itself.
With motion fade the Fade plugin cross-fades cards in place instead of scrolling.
Autoplay is off until its button is toggled on; it advances every autoplayInterval, stops on interaction, and the component itself pauses and resumes it rather than the plugin's mouse-enter rule.
With draggable the pointer drags the strip; otherwise drag is ignored.
Page changes are announced with a localisable announcement of the index and total.

keyboard: Tab reaches prev, the nav group, next and autoplay
Arrow keys move between dots inside the nav group; Enter or Space selects a page
With cardFocus the arrow keys move between cards
semantics: prev, next and dots are buttons with accessible names; the selected dot is pressed
the autoplay button is a toggle whose label says whether autoplay is on
page changes are announced through a live region

notes.text: The 4px selected-dot radius, the 40 and 48px image buttons and the dot opacities (0.6, 0.75, 1, 0.65) are constants in the styles files; the 4000ms autoplay interval and the slide speed 25 are constants in the hooks.
Slide motion is a physics simulation with a unitless speed, not a duration and curve; a renderer with timed easings must approximate it, and the kit's motion fields cannot carry it.

The dot's glyph is a pseudo-element the button's padding surrounds, so the hit area is 24 by 24px (8px glyph plus 8px padding each side) while the glyph is 8px; a selected dot is 24px wide of padding around a 16px bar.

The autoplay button's toggling and the announcement text are in useCarouselAutoplayButton.tsx and the carousel hook, which the kit's citation pattern cannot name for the former; the Embla options are read from useEmblaCarousel.ts.
Under forced colours a dot's glyph is painted white with a difference blend so it stays visible on any card; the nav and buttons keep a strokeWidthThin transparent outline that becomes visible.
